prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with knee injury after a rear-end collision. The patient had 3 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1267; do not mention it.)
text:
Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which the patient's vehicle was struck from behind. The patient reported immediate pain and swelling in the right knee, with difficulty bearing weight on the first day after the incident. Examination at the initial visit revealed moderate effusion, tenderness along the medial joint line, and restricted range of motion, with flexion limited to approximately 100 degrees. Neurovascular status of the lower extremity was intact. Radiographs were obtained and showed no acute fracture or dislocation. The working diagnosis was a soft tissue injury of the right knee, with suspected medial meniscal involvement.

At the second visit, the patient reported partial improvement in swelling but persistent pain with stairs and prolonged standing. Treatment consisted of a compression wrap, a hinged knee brace, activity modification, and a prescribed course of anti-inflammatory medication with a home physical therapy exercise program. At the third visit, range of motion had improved to approximately 120 degrees, effusion was reduced, and the patient was ambulating with a normal gait. Ongoing outpatient physical therapy was recommended, along with a follow-up evaluation if symptoms persist.
